# FloatProgress { #anylumino.FloatProgress }

```python
FloatProgress(
    value=0.0,
    min=0.0,
    max=100.0,
    description='',
    bar_style='',
)
```

Float progress bar control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                     | Default   |
|-------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `0.0` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `0.0` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `100.0` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| bar_style | optional | Progress-bar style name such as ``'success'`` or ``'warning'``. | `''` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.FloatProgress.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
